what_r3_proves: The already-bound R11 Teacher action_laws quantiles can be consumed by a Student-owned distributional belief head.
The distributional target path is finite, monotone and trainable on frozen authorized history.
Head-only distributional gradients can be isolated completely from the production Student.
The GTX1060 6GB has ample compute and memory headroom for this belief head.
what_r3_does_not_prove: That distributional belief should modify the production Shared Decision Core.
That distributional belief improves the existing Direction/Requested-Risk objective.
That any market-information verdict should be changed.

next_authorized_shadow.purpose: Compare head-only distributional learning with a disposable copy whose Shared Decision Core is also allowed to receive distributional gradients, while preserving all production authority and measuring compatibility with the existing Direction/Requested-Risk objective.
